nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-026B opened Chart of Accounts read-only; the list is reachable but no G/L account rows or VAT account candidates are visible.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: VAT setup groups need account candidates. The current account basis is blank or insufficient, so VAT setup must wait.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: A minimal account structure must be planned before any account setup write.
Only after TARGET-026E defines the exact accounts and stop gates.
Requires Sales/Purchase VAT account candidates or newly created accounts.
Can continue after account/VAT dependency path is classified.
Customer creation depends on posting group and VAT decisions.

queueChangesMade: Select TARGET-026E before TARGET-026C because no VAT account candidates are visible.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the blank chart-of-accounts finding into a concrete, reviewable account setup plan before any write.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not create accounts without a specific account list and beginner-facing explanation.
Do not claim SKR04 or tax-advisor final correctness.
Do not unlock VAT setup or first master data until account dependencies are resolved.
requiredPreparation: Define account families and exact candidate account numbers/names.
Mark which accounts are foundation-only, VAT-relevant, posting-group-relevant, bank, inventory or fixed-asset relevant.
Prepare screenshot and reopen-proof requirements for a later controlled setup gate.

reason: A blank/insufficient Chart of Accounts requires a minimal account-structure plan before VAT setup or first master data creation.
